summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (new TimeElapsedColumn after BarColumn; Task.finished_time field; finished now derived from finished_time; _reset clears it; capture-on-update and capture-on-advance inside the lock), rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow), rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with runtime imports inside the method and TYPE_CHECKING import for the annotation), CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry), tests/test_palette.py (test_rich_cast), and tests/test_progress.py (new test_time_elapsed_column, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, and a regenerated test_columns expected string). The test_columns expected output was derived by hand-tracing clock reads, not by running the test; the bar widths and elapsed counts were checked by counting characters in the edited line. Nothing was run, so the test results are unverified.
